ache.title: Anniversary banners: the party is for their sales
ache.note: This one covers Honkai: Star Rail’s first anniversary banners. Anniversaries feel like a celebration you should join, and that mood is exactly what sells pulls. Nero made this while still stuck in the loop, and the hype in it is the loop talking. A birthday for a game is not a reason to spend.
watch: hype from someone still in the loop
ache.tip: Celebrate by playing, not paying. If you didn’t plan to spend before the event, you don’t need to now.
lines: it’s the game’s birthday, not yours
party hats don’t make pulls cheaper
he was hyped. I’m the hangover
